description: The public keys Pulse signs its price prints with, as PEM and JWK, plus the signing algorithm and the exact canonical string format — everything needed to verify a signed print yourself, OFFLINE, with no network call to Pulse. Use it to write your own verifier, or to audit what pulse_verify_print (this pack's ready-made offline checker) is checking against. Needs NO API key. Example: pulse_key_ring({}).
name: pulse_key_ring
